title: pm-dispatch + scripts: grade by lookup table, triage sets area and issue type, new area label set
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing gate: child of epic #35205, filed by seat 1 on the maintainer's 「立一张专题卡，开始执行」 (2026-11-18 14:43Z). Source order: /mnt/project-files/pm-orders/objectstack/seat1/priorities-rollout-2026-11-18.md. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What changes

pm-dispatch and its scripts follow the new rules in #35205:
- `references/filing-gate.md`: replace the grading criteria section with the lookup tables.
- Triage:
  - First touch sets the `area:*` and the issue type.
  - Delete the "key re-grade" step.
  - Rewrite `references/triage.md`:24 ("public cards only grade security+p1") to the new security table.
- Claim order: p0, then p1, then the area or sub-epic the maintainer named.
- Delete "pause means demote to p3" and the Restart-grade demotion.
- New rules:
  - A card blocking another repo's p1 takes the same grade.
  - In-flight cards are not regraded.
  - A public card's grade line never names a security mechanism.
- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`:634-684 moves to the new area set. The objectui repository no longer exists, so drop it.
- `SKILL.md`:128: the area description follows.
- Platform checklist: in each of the 16 areas, the `"axis"` field moves to the new area. The PR writes the old-to-new mapping.
- Scripts that read the old `bug` type label (`check-half-states.mjs`:3672 and others) move to the issue type first. The old type labels retire after that.

## Done when

- One PR (Tier H: `.claude/skills/**`). `pm:awaiting-merge` and a review request go out the moment it is ready. The maintainer merges.
- Every gate that reads area or type labels is green on the new set.
